text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program is to cultivate international talents with a comprehensive knowledge of computer technology. International students undertaking th program will: Master the fundamental knowledg and theoretical principles underpinning computer science; Accquire knowledge and operating processes of core technologies an hardware; Be made familiar with the latest frontier knowledge and emerging technologies in computer science; Be trained to develop their research skills, and the creative and practical application of research; Adopt professional, entrepreneurial and application of their computer science skills and knowledge; Acquire, through theory and practice, cross-cultural literacy and improved proficiency in English, and enhanced Chinese language skills; 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program provides 10 main courses for international students. Calculus, Linear Algebra, Discrete Mathematics, Chinese Language, Introduction to Chinese Culture, Data Structure, Database, Program Design of High-level Language, Operating System, Principles of Compiling, Computer Network, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence. 3. Why Choose To Study This Course Editor Notes: It has Computer science basic theory teaching and practical application ability training. Besides learning basic computer course, this course also have artificial intelligence, multimedia technology, two professional direction course, cultivate innovative research and engineering applied talents Drawing on the sophisticated teaching and research facilities as well as rich experience of the professors with extraordinary research power The program puts much premium on the cultivation of students' innovative and analytical thinking and ability Encouraging students to participate in research project with a view to acquiring hands-on experience under the guidance of professors. 4. Career Prospects Editor Notes: This program offers different kinds of careers for international students in the future. Graduates will possess the capabilities needed to work in industrial organizations, research departments, and computer hardware/software development organizations, and governmental departments. They will also be equipped to contribute in the areas of computing research, engineering development, and other related fields. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: SCUT is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. South China University of Technology (SCUT) is one of China's leading universities. South China University of Technology is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. It operates under the direct leadership of the State Ministry of Education. SCUT is a member of Project 985 and Project 211 which means top excellent in teaching and research, it is one of the universities approved by MOE to accept international students on Chinese Government Scholarships, Learn More>> 6. School of Computer Science & Engineering Editor Notes: It is the first school to be engaged in research and teaching on computer in our country. 6.1 Introduction of the Department School of Computer Science & Engineering (SCSE) is one of the units of the colleges and universities in our country that engaged in research and teaching on computer. There are 2 doctoral programs, 4 master degree programs, as well as 4 undergraduate programs. Computer application technology is one of the key disciplines in Guangdong province, and computer science and technology is the first batch of brand-name professional in Guangdong province. 6.2 Facilities and Achievements Facilities: The three research centers includes Next generation network technology, High performance computing, and Enterprise computing technology. Achievements: Computer network, especially the research of Internet fundamental theory, network management and security, a next generation network technology The key high-performance calculation theory, the grid computing, large-scale parallel file management technology, the application of the mass media information retrieval and processing technology Unified portal of enterprise calculation, content management based on XML, the introduction of e-commerce and business intelligence, covering the basic theory, the core technology and application demonstration of computer network. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus.
